description: Wind Turbines in Colorado 2013 is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Industrial-scale onshore wind turbine facility information, turbine technical specifications and corresponding locations in the Colorado produced by the US Geological Survey (USGS) as of July 22, 2013. Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Energy. Its tags are bic, colorado, environment, wind energy, usgs. The table has 27 columns. Attribution on the portal: CEO. The portal shows 2015-02-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
